release_stage: Reviewable draft research candidate; new Pages publication is not yet verified and follows the protected repository workflow.
scope: Exact reviewed source, wheel and paper with canonical notices. The animation is explicitly synthetic. The unchanged 100-event pilot retains 76,344 measurements, 89 inadequate screens, 11 passing chi-square screens and two historical archival follow-ups; every mass remains unresolved. A distinct 2023 known-system source pack and three frozen joint model/noise alternatives all fail adequacy. No reliable known-system mass or new black-hole interpretation is accepted. Software import, fitting, export and replay are separate computational checks. Original pilot per-point observations remain external; the independently licensed 2023 native source pack is distributed unchanged.
native_observation_rights: Source-pack CC-BY4.0 author data and public HST terms remain in the ZIP and SOURCEPACK_CITATIONS_AND_RIGHTS.md; BHSM licensing does not replace them.
installation: Extract the portable product ZIP and open product/. Python 3.11+: Start_Blackhole_Tracker.cmd on Windows, or python -m pip install . then python -m bhtracker serve --open. Joint research explicitly uses Start_Blackhole_Tracker_Joint.cmd, --astrometry, or the source/wheel [astrometry] extra; opening a page never installs dependencies. Import the separate reviewed source-pack ZIP.
input_privacy: Local app binds loopback; static Museum does not upload measurements or run inference.
